title: Uniform bound transfers to the maximum admissible code size
statement: Fix natural numbers $n$, $d$, $w$ and $K$. If every $(n,d,w)$-admissible code $C$ satisfies $\abs{C} \le K$, then the maximum size of an $(n,d,w)$-admissible code satisfies $A_0(n,d,w) \le K$.
hypotheses_covered: K is an upper bound on the size of every (n,d,w)-admissible code
replaced: If every $(n,d,w)$-admissible code $C$ has $\abs{C} \le K$, then $A_0(n,d,w) \le K$.
